title: oreobolus distichus
intro: Oreobolus distichus, commonly known as the New Zealand orchid grass, is a species of flowering plant in the sedge family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Oreobolus distichus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential side effects of using Oreobolus distichus for medicinal purposes.
